_comment: Mutations that reintroduce the three screener-outage defects.
C1: a feed DISABLED BY CONFIGURATION must still raise the
RISK-CONTROL OUTAGE alarm. The escalation lives in the
reconnect-failure handler, which a disabled feed never creates.
C2: a regime-change stop must not be ARMED on a deployment whose
screener feed cannot deliver the regime data. C2-B is the
FALSE-POSITIVE mutation: it makes the predicate refuse a
protection that WOULD have worked, which must also be caught.
C3: one symbol's failure must not throw away the context for the
others, one outage must not cost one timeout per symbol, and
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: C1-A: the disabled-feed branch never detects a strategy whose regime-change stop depends on the feed
mutations.needle:
dynamic_possible = bool(
                    getattr(config, "SYMBOL_SELECTION_ALLOW_DYNAMIC", False)
                )
                regime_at_risk = self._regime_change_controls_at_risk()
mutations.replace:
dynamic_possible = bool(
                    getattr(config, "SYMBOL_SELECTION_ALLOW_DYNAMIC", False)
                )
                regime_at_risk = False  # MUTANT: a dependency is never seen

mutations.label: C1-B: the disabled-feed branch never escalates at all (the original defect)
mutations.needle:
regime_at_risk = self._regime_change_controls_at_risk()
                if dynamic_possible or regime_at_risk:
mutations.replace:
regime_at_risk = self._regime_change_controls_at_risk()
                if False:  # MUTANT: never escalate

mutations.label: C2-A: the 503 guard never refuses anything
C2-B: the feed predicate is wrong (a deployment that CAN deliver the regime data is treated as one that cannot)
C2-C: the arming check is dropped, so a stop is armed even on a deployment with no feed
C3-A: one failing symbol aborts the whole context build again (the `break` that was replaced)
mutations.replace:
skipped.append(f"{target_pair} ({type(e).__name__}: {e})")
            break  # MUTANT: one failure kills the rest

mutations.label: C3-B: the per-call short-circuit is removed, so one outage costs one timeout PER symbol
C3-C: the degraded-context report is never emitted
